title: Enterprise Support: outcome precision and disposition for source-line debit assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — outcome precision and disposition for source-line debit assessment.

## Decision basis

For source-line debit assessment: Subtract original net amount and cumulative signed corrections from the reconstructed corrected fee, floor the additional debit at zero, then round half up to cents. Zero produces no financial write; with the reviewed US untaxed source amount equals pretax net amount and signed tax amount is zero.

## Hypothetical case

For source-line debit assessment: Suppose the reconstructed fee is hypothetically USD 150, the original net is USD 100 and signed prior corrections total USD 20. The additional debit is USD 30. With prior corrections of USD 60 instead, the debit floors at zero and creates no financial entry.
